releases.notes: Installer: allow installing inside an image build chroot (port check skipped)
Packages: a stopped package service now says 'start it in Package Center' instead of showing a Python connection error; new cross-package QA sweep (docs/packages-qa.md).
Package Center now tells you which service already holds a package port instead of failing with a raw Docker bind error; Forgejo moved to host port 3005.
Packages: fix a false share-write warning for named volumes; the whole catalog validates warning-free.
Packages: container health alerts, Docker-root disk preflight, channel filter, UID-aligned share writes; new Uptime Monitor and FreshRSS packages.
Packages: update notifications, purgable app data, disk-space preflight and PIN-safe catalog; new Syncthing and Forgejo packages.
Cameras: each camera's own retention setting is now enforced
Cameras: single-stream cameras record continuously over one RTSP session
Cameras: stream passwords are no longer written to ffmpeg logs
Cameras: continuous recording with retention, timeline playback, motion zones and a live HLS wall
Host: zram now really uses zstd and the swap tuning is no longer overridden by an older sysctl file
Host: an optional setup script adds zram swap and stops systemd-oomd from killing sessions at 50 % pressure
Radarr/Sonarr now use the download folder configured in Download Station instead of a phantom /home/qb-admin/Downloads, so imports land in the media library.
System: EthOS pauses heavy work and skips the OOM killer when the box runs out of memory, and reports why it was killed
Books: offline retry/cancel, locked-phone progress, offline reading without a session, faster large libraries, EPUB swipe and PDF pinch
Videos on the phone now browses series with seasons, subtitles, up-next autoplay, playback speed and cast, works offline with saved progress and without a valid session, and estimates download sizes.
System: a core update now restarts in seconds instead of being hard-killed after 90 s, and no longer reports interrupted downloads
Music: playlist downloads run four at a time (setting 1/2/4/6), roughly twice as fast
Books: an installable phone app at /books with background audiobooks and offline EPUB/PDF downloads
Music: every playlist shows how many tracks are already downloaded to the phone
Videos: new 480p · tiny download version, now the default — plus working delete for active downloads, no poster flicker and no lingering Tasks row.
Music: Polubione is a normal playlist (liked tracks download to the phone) and downloads resync when the app returns to the foreground
Videos: Select many films at once (phone and desktop) and download them in one go using your default version.
Music: the phone player is now the installable /music web app with offline playlist downloads; the Android APK is retired
